Title: 502455-2026: France – Construction work – Creation of an urban higher education campus on the Maret site in Dijon
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New construction/conversion into an urban university campus is highly relevant for sbp, as campus and university projects are preferred. Deduction because this is a French existing-building rehabilitation project without indications of special structural complexity or checking engineer services in Germany.
titel: Creation of an urban higher education campus on the Maret site in Dijon
kurzbeschreibung: Conversion and refurbishment of the former CROUS headquarters in Dijon into a shared urban campus for several higher education institutions (including Sciences Po, ENSA Dijon, ESM Bourgogne) with extensive structural rehabilitation, energy and safety upgrades, and new communal areas.
wettbewerb_art: Award of construction works (open procedure) for conversion and refurbishment of a university campus
gewinner: Several construction companies per trade, including PENNEQUIN (Lots 1 & 4), R CONSTRUCTION (Lot 2), CEM (Lot 3), DUC ET PRENEUF (Lot 5), PIER (Lot 6), BS LEDE (Lot 8), MENUISERIE LEBLOND (Lot 9), SMPP (Lot 10), BONGLET (Lot 14), ORONA (Lot 17), SANITEL (Lot 18), DROZ & CIE (Lot 19), EURO SONO ALEX T’REM (Lot 20)
gewinner_rolle: Construction companies / executing firms for individual trades
gewinner_kontakt: Total value of the construction contracts awarded in this notice: 10071599.05 EUR
projektbeteiligte:
Contracting authority: Rectorat de la région académique BFC (education authority, regional public body), Besançon.
Executing firms (selection): PENNEQUIN – Lot 1 Curage/Désamiantage/Déplombage and Lot 4 Terrassements généraux/VRD; R CONSTRUCTION – Lot 2 Démolitions/Gros oeuvre/Charpente métallique; CEM – Lot 3 Charpente bois; DUC ET PRENEUF – Lot 5 Espaces verts; PIER – Lot 6 Ravalement et nettoyage de façade; BS LEDE – Lot 8 Etanchéité; MENUISERIE LEBLOND – Lot 9 Menuiseries extérieures bois/Occultations; SMPP – Lot 10 Cloisons/Doublages/Faux plafonds; BONGLET – Lot 14 Peinture/Signalétique; ORONA – Lot 17 Appareils élévateurs; SANITEL – Lot 18 Chauffage/Ventilation/Plomberie; DROZ & CIE – Lot 19 Electricité courants forts/faibles/SSI; EURO SONO ALEX T’REM – Lot 20 Equipements scénographiques.
Designers/structural engineers: -
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Conversion and refurbishment of an existing university building complex, no new build with recognisable exceptional structural complexity
- Pure award of construction works; design and structural services have apparently already been awarded and are not the subject of the TED notice
- Location outside DACH and without bridges or long-span special structures
- Medium-sized but rather conventional building refurbishment project
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project is located in France, checking engineer services according to the German system are not relevant
- It is a refurbishment/conversion without indications of exceptional structures or large spans
- No explicit tendering of checking or control structural engineering services identifiable
- Overall volume moderate, not a flagship project for international checking engineer business
baukosten_erklaerung: Read from the notice: value of all construction contracts awarded in the notice (construction works, approximately corresponding to cost groups 300/400)
naechste_schritte: No active steps required. Only passively monitor the project; no direct contact, as structural design is not part of the notice and construction works have already been awarded.
notes: Project: transformation of the former CROUS headquarters into a shared campus for several higher education institutions (Sciences Po, ENSA Dijon, ESM Bourgogne) with 20 lots, 15 of which are in this AOO. Focus areas: rehabilitation, accessibility, energy refurbishment, fire protection, shared spaces and technical facility management. The TED notice concerns only the award of construction works; design and structural services are not described. For sbp, not a priority project either as design or as checking engineer commission.
